entities.name: Sivvi en-Vec
entities.description: Granddaughter of Tant Jova and a skilled warrior of the Vec tribe on Rath who rebelled against Volrath's rule and later fought the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Tant Jova
entities.description: Elderly leader of the Vec tribe on Rath.

entities.name: Vec
entities.description: A tribe on Rath whose traditional weapon is the toten-vec.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane where the Vec tribe lives.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Rebel leader and uniter of peoples who fought alongside Sivvi.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler of Rath whose disappearance caused disorder.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Fortress on Rath that rebels infiltrated.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: Daughter of Starke, rescued from the dungeons of the Stronghold.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Owner of the portal used to reach Dominaria.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where Sivvi and Eladamri arrived.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Lord of Phyrexia who came to Dominaria himself.

events.summary: Sivvi led rebels into the Stronghold with Eladamri to destroy the Predator, but the plan failed.
events.quote: Sivvi led a group of rebels into the Stronghold with Eladamri

events.summary: Sivvi and Eladamri used Belbe's portal to reach Dominaria with Takara, whom they had rescued.
events.quote: Sivvi and Eladamri used Belbe 's portal to get to Dominaria along with Starke 's daughter, Takara

events.summary: They arrived near Llanowar and prepared the locals for the invasion.
events.quote: They arrived near Llanowar and began preparing the locals for the invasion.

events.summary: Sivvi and Eladamri chose to end their lives together rather than be killed by Yawgmoth's Black Cloud of Death.
events.quote: They chose to end their lives together rather than be killed by Yawgmoth 's Black Cloud of Death

relations.note: respect blossomed into an ill-fated love
relations.quote: The warriors' respect between the two blossomed into an ill-fated love over the year of the war.
